title: WO sidebar separates its four views and their addresses while navigation guards retain history
steps: Run the real mounted App sidebar tests together with WO address and browser-history navigation-guard tests through run.cmd.
Require the named mounted-sidebar test, separate Research and legacy Dubai-anchor test, view-scoped Settings address test and zero suite failures.
expect: Four WO links belong to one Website Opportunities sidebar group, separate from Invitations.
Research and legacy Dubai anchors resolve to Research; Places and Settings keep their own addresses.
Cancelled navigation and history traversal preserve the current editor; accepted navigation changes its route.
All selected tests pass without skip.
fence: Mounted production App with linkedom, production address parser and navigation guard. No browser layout, pixel overflow, live API or settings-draft persistence is proved by this command; the previous manual acceptance remains in the change journal.

tests: Website Opportunities has four distinct view links in its own sidebar group
Research is a separate view and old Dubai anchors still open it
each view reads and writes only its own section; Settings writes only view=settings
